title: Gulf countries targeted by fresh Iranian attacks as repatriation still underway
summary: Iran has launched a new wave of missile and drone attacks on Gulf neighbours hosting US forces after Iranian president Masoud Pezeshkian's initial apology to neighbouring countries on March 7 was pushed back by Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps.
